subject: Re: Rather you than me
author: ZombieTron
body:
I know what you mean Boot, one of the reasons I stopped learning last time was due to a very bad driving practice with my Mum.

It was the first time I had driven my Mums car, so to be on the safe side we went to the HUGE Sainsbury's car park on Sunday afternoon when it was closed so the car park was completely empty. My Mum held on for dear life and made me so nervous it set me back years!!! But I think Xandu is a little more patient and calm then my Mum, but if it doesn't work out practicing with Xandu I have a couple of friends who offered to practice with me too. And I am much more determined to pass my test now. 🙂

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Rather you than Me
author: BootlegGiant
body:
Good for you Zombie, I do hope you carry on with your lessons but beware of being co driven by either loved ones or family members as you will test their patience to the extreme. And well done to Xandu for having the gazzongas to co drive you. Dont you hate pedestrians the way they think you will stop for them.
